Nothing earth-shattering and nothing out of the ordinary...

Simply a small, stylish storage option for the bathroom or for the whole house. The shape makes it easy to put several of the small bowls together.

> _I recommend a matt PLA for this._

> _Models were **roughly** generated via AI, photos were edited, adjusted, and post-processed._
>
> _Subsequently, a 3D model was created for each using AI and also post-processed to provide you with appropriate quality_
>
